note: Sample suit proving the four-crew framework. Cast is reserved away from all 22 Major Arcana species.

suit.name: Cups
suit.coreRule: All subjects anatomically bird; streetwear fitted to bird anatomy; no humanoid forms; no gore.

cards.name: Ace of Cups
cards.coreMeaning: New love, open heart, emotional source
cards.description: A heron lifts a brimming dew-vessel as a fountain overflows around it.
cards.pose: Standing tall in shallow canal water, neck curved up, one vessel balanced, water spilling in arcs.
cards.varietyNotes: Suit anchor species. Vertical heron silhouette + overflowing water reads 'source' instantly.
cards.gameplayFantasy: Opens emotion/bond resources; a wellspring card that fuels later Cups plays.

cards.name: Two of Cups
cards.description: Two mergansers mirror each other in a courtship display over still water.
cards.pose: Paired symmetrical pose, crests raised, beaks nearly touching above a shared reflection.
cards.varietyNotes: Two-subject mirror composition; raised crests give a distinct silhouette from the heron pips.
cards.gameplayFantasy: Pairs two units; enables synergy/commitment effects between bonded cards.

cards.name: Three of Cups
cards.description: Spoonbills splash together in a fountain in shared celebration.
cards.pose: Three birds mid-splash, wings half-open, spatulate bills lifted, water droplets flying.
cards.varietyNotes: Pink + spatulate bill clearly separates spoonbills from the heron and ducks of the suit.
cards.gameplayFantasy: Group buff; rewards having multiple friendly Cups units in play.

cards.name: Four of Cups
cards.description: A heron ignores an offered cup, hunched and sulking in the rain.
cards.pose: Hunched on one leg under heavy rain, head withdrawn into shoulders, back turned to a floating vessel.
cards.varietyNotes: Same heron as the Ace, inverted in mood — hunched/closed silhouette vs. the Ace's open lift.
cards.gameplayFantasy: A pass/skip or disengage card; trades a turn of action for later focus.

cards.name: Five of Cups
cards.description: Spilled vessels in a gutter; a bird turned away mourns, two cups still standing behind it.
cards.pose: Turned away and lowered, gaze on three tipped vessels; two upright vessels glow softly behind.
cards.varietyNotes: Wood Duck's ornate head pattern reads even when hunched; the two lit cups keep hope in frame.
cards.gameplayFantasy: Discard/sacrifice with a recovery clause — something remains after the loss.

cards.name: Six of Cups
cards.description: A fledgling shares food with an elder at the fountain's edge.
cards.pose: A small sanderling offers a berry up to a larger one; both gentle, soft evening light.
cards.varietyNotes: Small busy shorebird scale contrasts the suit's tall waders; two-size pairing tells the story.
cards.gameplayFantasy: Gift/transfer effect; move a resource or buff from one unit to another.

cards.name: Seven of Cups
cards.description: A bird gazes into floating illusory reflections and shimmering bubbles.
cards.pose: Head tilted up at seven drifting bubble-visions, each holding a different glowing object.
cards.varietyNotes: Dusk-violet accent and floating bubbles set it apart visually from the grounded pips.
cards.gameplayFantasy: Choose-one / scry effect; reveal options, but some are decoys.

cards.name: Eight of Cups
cards.description: A heron walks away from a neat row of arranged cups into the dusk rain.
cards.pose: Seen from behind mid-stride, leaving eight vessels lined on the bank, moon low ahead.
cards.varietyNotes: Back-turned departing heron is a unique reading angle within the suit.
cards.gameplayFantasy: Voluntary retreat; abandon a position to set up a stronger one elsewhere.

cards.name: Nine of Cups
cards.description: A content spoonbill sits before a proud row of full cups — the classic wish card.
cards.pose: Settled and satisfied, wings tucked, nine brimming vessels arrayed in an arc behind.
cards.varietyNotes: Pink + gold abundance palette signals the 'wish' high point of the suit.
cards.gameplayFantasy: Payoff card; cash in accumulated emotion resources for a strong reward.

cards.name: Ten of Cups
cards.description: A flock-family gathers under a rainbow arcing over the canal.
cards.pose: A family group close together at the water, wings raised toward a rainbow of ten lights.
cards.varietyNotes: Multi-subject group + rainbow is the emotional summit; warm gold lifts it out of the grays.
cards.gameplayFantasy: Capstone synergy; rewards a full board of bonded Cups units.

cards.name: Fledgling of Cups
cards.description: The youngest of the Tidewatch, a small sanderling bearing a sealed dew-vessel.
cards.pose: Bright-eyed, mid-skitter along the wet bank, holding a tiny capped vessel out to deliver.
cards.varietyNotes: Court Fledgling = smallest cast member, messenger energy; distinct tiny silhouette.
cards.gameplayFantasy: Cheap utility/messenger unit; draws or delivers an emotion resource.

cards.name: Outrider of Cups
cards.coreMeaning: Romantic pursuit, idealism, following the heart
cards.description: The Tidewatch's mobile actor, a merganser skimming the canal on a quest of feeling.
cards.pose: Low fast flight skimming the water surface, crest swept back, a vessel clutched in its talons.
cards.varietyNotes: Court Outrider = always in motion; only dynamic flight pose among the Cups courts.
cards.gameplayFantasy: Mobile striker; carries/charges emotion effects across the board.

cards.name: Matron of Cups
cards.description: The inner master of the Tidewatch, a poised spoonbill enthroned at the fountainhead.
cards.pose: Seated and serene on a fountain rim, neck in a soft curve, a still vessel cradled close.
cards.varietyNotes: Court Matron = poised, inward mastery; pink regalia distinguishes her from the Elder.
cards.gameplayFantasy: Support/healer leader; amplifies and protects bonded Cups units.

cards.name: Elder of Cups
cards.coreMeaning: Emotional command, calm authority, wisdom of feeling
cards.description: The crew boss of the Tidewatch, a monumental heron ruling the calm harbor at dusk.
cards.pose: Standing tall and still on a harbor post, wings folded, gaze level over calm water.
cards.varietyNotes: Court Elder = monumental, external authority; the suit's flagship heron at full command.
cards.gameplayFantasy: Faction leader; command effects that steady and rally the whole Cups crew.
